suggestions.reason: This assertion tests adherence to a naming convention the skill itself defines (labs-page.json) rather than a substantive content requirement - a baseline run with no knowledge of that convention can never pass it by design. It's still a fair discriminator for consistency across future runs (worth keeping), but shouldn't be read as a content-quality gap.

eval_feedback.overall: Strong pass; the only failure is the skill-specific filename convention, which this baseline had no way to know about.
